text: it just literally happens on like any edit now i just moved around as mesh a few times and each time it said 72 collapsed and im literally jsut moving the model around / rotating it in full. i literrally ctrl + a so there is no chance im not
resolution: Second false-positive in the same guard (countUnsafeFaceEdits, framework/gpu/3d.zig), collapse branch this time: any triangle whose after-area was under the absolute 1e-12 floor counted as 'collapsed' — including triangles that were ALREADY zero-area before the drag. Imported/generated meshes carry degenerate tris, so every gizmo drag (even a pure translate of a Ctrl+A full selection) re-reported the same constant count (72 on the user's model). Fix: a face degenerate before the drag is skipped entirely; only a transition into degeneracy relative to its own before-area (a2 < b2*1e-6 with b2 above the floor) counts. Combined with req_2754's rigid-motion exemption, full-selection move/rotate can no longer trip the guard. Needs a Zig rebuild to take effect.
